purpose: Canonical account universe and provenance for the Woods Run daily X reply scan

discovery_list_catalog.use: Discovery sources only until individual member accounts are verified and deduplicated into x_reply_watchlist.csv.
discovery_list_catalog.excluded_categories: Wildlife-heavy, generic environment/climate, ecology-dominant, public-land-only, and ambiguous non-business lists unless later individually justified.

update_policy: Merge verified relevant accounts from additional public X lists into x_reply_watchlist.csv by handle, deduplicate case-insensitively, preserve source-list provenance, and do not remove existing accounts unless explicitly requested.
